Title: CF有多个组织时部署报错
Description: 我的Cloudflare账户链接了多个组织，在自动部署该项目时，发生了错误无法完成部署，错误信息如下：
```
✘ [ERROR] More than one account available but unable to select one in non-interactive mode.
  Please set the appropriate `account_id` in your Wrangler configuration file.
  Available accounts are (`<name>`: `<account_id>`):
```
虽然设置了CF_ACCOUNT_ID的环境变量，但仍然提示无法指定账户，麻烦作者排查一下，兼容这种情况

You must provide a category number (1-3). Your response must follow this format exactly:

CATEGORY: [category number]
REASONING: [your reasoning here, including specific reasons why an issue would be hard to dockerize if choosing category 3]
llm_response:
CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about a deployment error with Cloudflare when a user has multiple organizations linked to their account. The error occurs because the system cannot automatically select which Cloudflare account to use in non-interactive mode, despite the user having set the CF_ACCOUNT_ID environment variable. 

This is a configuration issue that can be verified without needing to build or run the code. The solution would likely involve ensuring the correct account_id is properly set in the Wrangler configuration file or verifying that the environment variable is being correctly passed and recognized. 

A reviewer can analyze this issue by examining the configuration files, deployment scripts, and how environment variables are handled in the project without needing to actually build and deploy the application. The verification would involve checking if the proposed solution correctly addresses the configuration issue, which can be done through code review and documentation analysis.
